column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/vdelay_edges.onsa tests=15 evaluated=14 unavailable=0 skipped=1 waiting=0
@ an integer d is a plain delay
@ d = MAX is the longest delay and the ring wraps
@ a d just under MAX weights the older sample almost fully
@ init fills the values before the start
render vdelay_edges.vd_init sr=0x41000000 params d=0x3fc00000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ init at d = MAX fills the first MAX outputs
render vdelay_edges.vd sr=0x41000000 params d=0xff800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000]
render vdelay_edges.vd sr=0x41000000 params d=0x7fc00000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000]
@ d above MAX is clamped to MAX
@ MAX = 1 is always a delay of one sample
@ F64 signals interpolate the same way
- an echo with a delay of three samples
